cohort: 298 children from a Detroit-based birth cohort
finding: Multiple factors were associated with neonatal gut microbiome composition, including maternal race-ethnicity, breastfeeding, mode of delivery, marital status, exposure to environmental tobacco smoke, and indoor pets.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to be independently associated with neonatal gut microbiome composition.
followup_time: median age = 1.2 months (neonates), median age = 6.6 months (infants)
